why: The student is right that the printed values are estimates, but the main claim, that starting at page 3 would change the page ranks, is the documented wrong rule that ranks depend on the start page; the chain mixes, so the limiting ranks are the same from any start.

concepts.quote: starting at page 3 would change the ranks
concepts.why: By the basic limit theorem the ranks of a mixing chain do not depend on the start page; only the short-run estimate would differ.
A short 100-move run only estimates the ranks, but the student gives no reasoning from the counts or the run length.
The answer says nothing about vector-matrix multiplication or exact computation.
The answer makes no claim about running the program.
